episodeTitle.en: How 80,000 companies build with AI: Products as organisms and the death of org charts | Asha Sharma
episodeTitle.zh: 8万家公司如何借助AI进行建设：产品如有机体，组织结构图已死 | 阿莎·夏尔马

guestBioOfficial.en: Asha Sharma leads AI product strategy at Microsoft, where she works with thousands of companies building AI products and has unique visibility into what’s working (and what’s not) across more than 15,000 startups and enterprises. Before Microsoft, Asha was COO at Instacart, and VP of Product & Engineering at Meta, notably leading product for Messenger. *What you’ll learn:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 阿莎·夏尔马（Asha Sharma）在微软领导人工智能产品战略，负责与数千家开发AI产品的公司合作，并对超过15,000家初创企业和企业的做法有独特的洞察力。在加入微软之前，阿莎曾是Instacart的首席运营官，并在Meta担任产品与工程副总裁，特别是在Messenger方面负责产品。在本期节目中，我们讨论了： • Cash App如何突破重围，成为消费者应用的成功案例

title.en: How 80,000 companies build with AI: Products as organisms and the death of org charts | Asha Sharma
title.zh: 8万家公司如何借助AI进行建设：产品如有机体，组织结构图已死 | 阿莎·夏尔马

summary.en: Asha frames modern AI products as living “organisms” that think, learn, and evolve, and predicts the death of traditional org charts as agent-based teams become the norm. She draws on working with 80,000+ companies building with AI to explain what separates the successes from the failures. The conversation covers how enterprises should reorganize around AI and why products must be designed for continuous, adaptive intelligence.
summary.zh: Asha 把现代 AI 产品比作会思考、学习、进化的“有机体”，并预测随着智能体团队成为常态，传统组织架构将走向消亡。她基于与 8 万多家用 AI 构建产品的公司合作的经验，解释了成败之分。对话涵盖企业应如何围绕 AI 重新组织，以及为何产品必须为持续、自适应的智能而设计。
